purpose: Real-world botanical references for discussion and later model calibration; not runtime generation settings.
mappingPolicy: Specific common names retain their botanical referent. Generic names use plausible size/type representatives informed by measured game assets, as requested. No game species identity is claimed verified.

definitions.sizeObservations: Published mature/landscape size ranges with original units and context retained. An identical lower/upper pair denotes a single reported size, not a population distribution. Not minimum spacing.
definitions.coldHardiness: USDA/RHS categories or reported cold tolerance. Not annual mean temperature or optimum growth temperature.
definitions.lightPreference: Qualitative exposure preference; not a measured shade mortality curve.
definitions.crownDensity: Qualitative source description when available; does not equal canopy opacity.
definitions.null: Not established by the reviewed sources; not zero, unlimited tolerance, or an inferred default.
definitions.quantitativeModelInputs: Deliberately unset until a defined model and suitable measurements exist. FAO ecological ranges are preserved separately, not coerced into game curves.
